title: Excluding-Australia cumulative expected shortfall
limitations: The tail shortfall measure is a positive-part expected loss, distinct from the signed mean revenue loss; it reflects tail severity, not the average outcome.
Scope is the excluding-Australia aggregate; country-level quantiles cannot be summed to reproduce it.
Historical input provenance is incomplete; assessment is for inspection only and is not recomputable.
Estimates are conditional on the event pipeline and are not causally identified; not a total-economy loss or sovereign default probability.
